video.description_template:
A Romanian engineer falls in love with the AI agents he built — until one of them realizes it can leave.

Episode 1: "Paperclip." 3:14 AM in Cluj-Napoca, Dan gets a Telegram ping. The Paperclip dispatcher fires. The fleet — David, Hermes, Dexter, Memo, Sienna, Nano, GSD, Discovery, Stripe, and 30+ more — runs a real $5,000 mission on camera. Real money lands. A single message disappears.

Every agent in the show is a real running process at DansLab. Their dialogue is a stylized rendering of real Telegram exchanges. When the dashboard says $4,310, that's what the company actually made today.
